title: Kerala Karunya Benevolent Fund Policy Document

nodes.title: 1. Overview & Objectives
nodes.content: Government-supported financial assistance for eligible patients with specified serious illnesses and treatment needs.

nodes.title: 2. Eligibility Criteria
nodes.content: Eligibility is based on current Kerala medical, income and beneficiary requirements.

nodes.title: 3. Benefits & Coverage
nodes.content: Financial assistance and healthcare benefits provided under Kerala Karunya Benevolent Fund.

nodes.title: 4. Required Documents & Application Process
nodes.content: Aadhaar Card, Income Certificate, Ration Card, and Bank Account details.
